Title: TC-16 Search is case-insensitive

Title: TC-17 Add multiple quantity from product page
Description: Verify the chosen quantity is added
Steps:
1. Tap the Apple Shimla row
2. Tap + twice (quantity 3)
3. Tap Add to cart
4. Tap Go to cart

Title: TC-18 Decrease quantity to zero removes the item
Description: Verify − at quantity 1 removes the line
Steps:
1. Open the cart
2. Tap − on Tomato
Expected Result: Tomato is removed from the cart; the subtotal is ₹60

Title: TC-19 FRESH10 coupon calculation
Description: Verify FRESH10 gives 10% off, capped at ₹100
Steps:
1. Open the cart
2. Enter FRESH10 and tap Apply
Expected Result: Discount is -₹10; with ₹40 delivery the total is ₹130

Title: TC-20 Stock limit from the Home Add button
Description: Verify a product can't be added beyond its stock
Steps:
1. On Home, tap ADD next to Spinach (stock 3) 5 times
2. Open the cart
Expected Result: 'Only 3 in stock' message appears; the cart has Spinach × 3

Title: TC-21 Delivery slot is saved on the order
Description: Verify the chosen slot is shown on the confirmation
Steps:
1. Go to Checkout and fill valid details
2. Select 'Tomorrow 8 AM - 10 AM'
3. Tap Place order
Expected Result: The success screen shows 'Delivery: Tomorrow 8 AM - 10 AM'

Title: TC-22 Pay with a numeric UPI ID
Description: Verify UPI IDs with digits are accepted
Steps:
1. Go to Checkout and fill valid details
2. Select UPI
3. Enter 9876543210@ybl
4. Tap Place order
Expected Result: The order is placed with payment 'UPI (9876543210@ybl)'

Title: TC-23 Order history shows the amount paid
Description: Verify My Orders shows the final total
Preconditions: An order is placed with the FRESH10 coupon
Steps:
1. Note 'Total paid' on the success screen
2. Tap View my orders
Expected Result: The order total in My Orders equals the Total paid amount

Title: TC-24 Logout clears the session and the cart
Description: Verify no data leaks after logout
Steps:
1. ⋮ → Profile → Log out
2. Press the device Back button
3. Log in again
Expected Result: Step 2 does not return to Home (the app exits or stays on Login). Step 3 shows an empty cart
